Implementation is complete. I built the team members screen in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`, using the Strata design system components already available in the project (`Card`, `DataTable`, `Menu`, `Dialog`, `AlertDialog`, `Select`, `TextField`, `Badge`, `Avatar`).

Summary of what's there:
- A `Card` with a `DataTable` listing 7 mock team members (name, avatar, email, role badge, relative "last active" time), including the current user (`patel.anuj1997@gmail.com`) tagged "You".
- Each row has a three-dot actions menu (`MenuTrigger`/`Menu`) where an admin can change the role (Owner/Admin/Member, with a checkmark on the current one) or remove the person — removal is guarded by an `AlertDialog` confirmation, and the sole remaining owner can't be demoted or removed.
- An "Invite" button in the card header opens a `Dialog` with an email field and a role `Select` (Admin/Member), disabled until the email looks valid; submitting adds a new "invited" member with no last-active date ("Never").

All data is mocked in-file; no other project files were touched.
